test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A man invested Rs. 4,400 at 10% and Rs. 7,500 at 8% simple interest. What amount (in Rs.) will he get from his investments after 12 years?
solution:
**Given:**

1st principal (P₁) = Rs.4400

Rate (R₁) = 10% ; Time (T) = 12 years

2nd principal (P₂) = 7500

Rate (R₂) = 8% ; Time (T) = 12 years

**Formula used:**

S.I = (P × R × T)/100

Where, S.I = simple interest

R = rate% ; T = time

**Calculation:**

Total S.I = (4400 × 10 × 12)/100 + (7500 × 8 × 12)/100

⇒ 440 × 12 + 75 × 96

⇒ 5280 + 7200

⇒ Rs.12480

Total amount = total S.I + total principal

⇒ 12480 + 4400 + 7500

⇒ Rs.24380

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.24380.**
